title: Introduction to Sovereign Debt and Country Risk
description: A practical on-ramp to sovereign debt and country risk for Indian investors and finance professionals who want to understand why governments borrow, how the market prices a country's creditworthiness, and what that means for portfolios. Covers the mechanics of sovereign borrowing, how credit rating agencies and bond spreads size up country risk, what happens when that risk turns into crisis, and how FIIs and Indian investors actually use country risk in decision-making. Anchored in India's own borrowing programme and sovereign rating, alongside real cases like Sri Lanka's 2022 default.
